name: animated-list

frames.best_why: All five notification cards are stacked and fully legible, showing the list at its fullest.

tagline: Notification cards spring in one by one and stack up.
summary: A vertical feed of notification cards that appear one after another with a spring, newest on top, pushing the earlier cards down as the list grows.
appearance: A stack of dark notification cards centred on black, newest at the top. Each card has a small coloured rounded-square icon with an emoji, a bold title, a relative time and a one-line subtitle.
behaviour: Cards spring in at the top one at a time and push earlier ones down; the list fills to five items and stops. Hovering a card scales it up slightly.
demo_content: Notifications: Payment received, New follower, New message, Order shipped and Meeting reminder.
search_phrases: feed of activity cards that pile up
cards slide in from the top
notification list for a landing page
toast cards accumulating in a column
new item appears at top of list
use_when: A landing page wants to show recent activity building up in front of the visitor.
avoid_when: Long feeds: the demo caps at five items, so older entries drop out of view.
customise: Pass the cards as children and set the per-item delay; the spring easing and stacking behaviour are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A handful of motion divs with one spring each; idle once the list is full.

a11y.note: Cards are clickable divs with no keyboard focus and the emoji icons have no labels; new items are not announced.

issues: The cards are clickable divs rather than buttons, so they cannot be reached by keyboard.
polish_why: Pleasant spring entrance and a tidy card design; the demo stops at five items.
